messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning to roll the `tiny_traffic_canary` config at 12:30 UTC today. Goal: route 1% of traffic to the quantized model path for perf validation. I'll flip unless someone else wants to own. Steps below.

maria: I can own smoke and metrics during the window. Prefer a 15-min quiet window. :+1:

alex: Confirmed — 12:30-12:45 UTC quiet window. Quick checklist:
- set flag: `config set tiny_traffic_canary=true --percent=1`
- verify traffic and latency in Console > Routes
- smoke request: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/internal/smoke -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq .status`
- rollback: `config set tiny_traffic_canary=false`

kevin: PR #4123 merged to main? I saw staging green but want a prod deploy check. @maria can you confirm the prod deploy happened?

maria: PR merged and prod artifact uploaded (build-2026-03-16). The prod deploy is green — just the flag flip left. I'll tail the prod logs and check 200/500 ratios once flipped.

sudha: I'll add a temporary PagerDuty alert: error-rate >0.5% over 1m or latency p95 increase >100ms over baseline. If it fires, who runs the rollback?

alex: Good plan. Maria will flip and owns the rollback for this window. Sudha will own the PD alert. Rollback criteria: error-rate >0.5% OR p95 delta >100ms for 3 consecutive samples. Rollback command repeated above. Also ensure `safe_defaults=true` remains set as the fallback.

maria: Copy. I'll post a flip timestamp and quick smoke results. @deploy-bot please annotate the flip in #deployments.

deploy-bot: Deploy event created: tiny_traffic_canary flip requested by maria at 2026-03-17T12:30:00Z. Link: https://console.redwood/deploys/98765

maria: flipped at 12:30 UTC. Initial smoke: 12/12 OK, latency +8ms median, no 5xxs. Monitoring dashboards are green so far.

kevin: Quick FYI — small logging tweak in #4130 needs an Alex review after the window, not blocking the flip. @alex pinged.

maria: 12:40 UTC — metrics stable, PD alert not triggered. Keeping at 1% for an extra 30m before any bump. If anyone sees oddness, ping @maria or @sudha. :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks all. If we plan to increase to 5% later, I'll file a short runbook note and schedule a follow-up check at 13:15 UTC. No objections so far?
